events.title: Attack UKMTO #176 17 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 140NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen. A Master of an LNG Tanker has reported being approached by a small skiff with seven persons onboard. The skiff fired two shots at the tanker whose armed Security Team fired two warning shots at the small skiff which forced them to alter course. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #175 16 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 78NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia. The Master of a tanker has reported being attacked by an RPG from a small boat, resulting in damage to the aft port quarter. Crew are accounted for and reported safe. A complete damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #174 16 October 2026 UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 68NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia of a tanker stuck by an unknown projectile. All crew are reported safe and have been evacuated. There is no reported environmental impact at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities are investigating.

Attack UKMTO #173 14 October 2026 UKMTO WARNING 173-26 UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. A 19,000 tonne Container ship was struck by an unknown projectile whilst conducting an outbound SoH transit. The vessel reports minor damage, no casualties and was able to continue on its passage. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

Attack UKMTO #165 11 October 2026 UKMTO Suspicious Activity 165-26 UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman. The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Update 001: UKMTO has reclassified this incident as an attack following confirmation that the tanker was struck by an Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Local authorities are assisting in the evacuation of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact is unknown at time of update. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #164 11 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. The CSO reported a tanker transiting outbound had been struck on the port side by an unidentified projectile, resulting in damage to the vessel. All crew members were reported safe, and no environmental impact was reported at the time of the attack. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO. Advisory UKMTO #163 10 October 2026 UKMTO have received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman. Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.
